G001.target_statement: Consolidate ebooks and course PDFs into a single application so that all reading material can be opened in one place.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: T039 明确要求同一应用同时处理 PDF 与电子书，以便在“just one single place”打开；T041 对“everything in one sort of place”的复述回答 Yeah, yeah.；T037 说明现状是阅读分散在多处。主体、对象（电子书+课程 PDF）与结果（单一应用/单一处）均与目标一致，未增加格式或范围。
supported_parts: 同一应用处理两种格式

G002.target_statement: Reduce the number of steps needed to import course articles and PDFs from the school portal onto the iPad, without first downloading them to a computer.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T037 直接说希望“use less steps to actually import this content to my ipad”，同段还说不要先下载到电脑再打开 Drive 导出 PDF（not to download it to my computer）；T031 把门户阅读体验称为 cumbersome。目标把对象限定为学校门户的课程文章/PDF，并从同句保留“不经电脑下载”的否定条件，未扩大到全部阅读。
supported_parts: 减少导入 iPad 的步骤

G003.target_statement: Provide an export action that sends course reading material directly to one chosen destination, such as Google Drive or a Kindle account.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: T047 在被问“门户里理想功能”时提出 export feature，并给出 Google Drive 与 Kindle account 两个去处；T055 把“export this material to one only place”列为第一优先。目标保留“一个选定目的地”和两个示例，没有替受访者固定具体目的地（他说 I don't know）。
supported_parts: Google Drive 与 Kindle 账户示例

G004.target_statement: Save valuable course PDFs into a personal student library so that they remain accessible after the course or semester ends.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: T051 说学期结束后“the material is not available anymore”，并提出 student library / personal library 保存 relevant content；T055 第二优先为 save these valuable resources ... check them later。目标保留“有价值的课程 PDF”“个人/学生资料库”“课后仍可访问”三个要素，未扩展到所有阅读内容。
supported_parts: 保存有价值的课程 PDF

G005.target_statement: Let students categorize and filter their reading material by the month or year in which they read it, so that they can find it again later.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: T055 第三优先明确要“categorize in time”，并按“month or the year”过滤检索，理由是常记得“I read this in my course of spring 2023”而不是书名或 ISBN。目标是分类+按时间过滤以找回资料，时间粒度保留为月/年；T064 的“when they're added”与其原话不一致，已作为问题保留而不写入目标。
supported_parts: 用于找回以前读过的资料

G006.target_statement: Show how far the reader is through the current chapter as a percentage, so that long chapters feel less daunting.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T049 明确希望显示“how much percentage of the chapter you are right now”，并在抱怨整本百分比显得漫长后说“I would love to have like by chapter ... This way I get less anxious”。目标保留“按章”“百分比”“降低畏难/焦虑”的结果，未设具体阈值或指标。
supported_parts: 目的是减轻漫长感/焦虑

G007.target_statement: Have the school provide its own online reading application in which professors' articles are available directly on the student's iPad.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: T057 明确说“the school should have its own application for for online reading”，并解释教授直接发文章、学生在 iPad 上就能读到。主体（学校提供）、范围（学校在线阅读）与结果（文章直接可用）均来自原句，未把责任或实现方式写死。
supported_parts: 学校自建在线阅读应用
文章直接在 iPad 上可读

G008.target_statement: Have the existing Kindle app also manage PDFs.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T043 在“独立应用还是现有门户”的追问下回答“it will be easier if my existing kindle app can manages Pdfs”，是明确的实现方式偏好，强度为“会更方便”而非必须；T023 说明目前 PDF 无法导入 Kindle，构成该偏好的背景。目标只保留“现有 Kindle 应用也能管理 PDF”，未加格式细节。
supported_parts: 现有 Kindle 应用管理 PDF
强度为更方便而非必须

G009.target_statement: Include the school online-reading application at no separate cost to students.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 问句是“Would you pay for that application”，受访者先说已付很多钱，再答“They should be included”，即不应由学生另行付费。目标只保留“不另收费/应被包含”，未指定纳入学费或具体承担方；该未定点写入 context 与问题。
